title: Quit Wordle 3-4 months ago. Life has genuinely never been better.
summary_en: Quit Wordle 3-4 months ago. Life has genuinely never been better. Played every single day for years. Had a 147-day streak at one point. Used to consistently solve in 3-4 guesses, occasionally 2. Back then it actually felt like a game of skill, rather than whatever psychological torture experiment it has become today. Towards the end, it was basically a dice roll whether the word was something reasonable or some absolute bullshit with four possible answers that all share the same letters. You can call me bad at Wordle, low vocabulary, whatever. I don't mind lol. I know I've done my best. But…
